title: Sandbox Innovation Grant (practice)
deadline_note: Not a real grant. Use it to test the browser agent end to end.
amount: Nothing - this is a practice form

summary.at_a_glance: A fake application hosted inside this portal. It has a login wall, a two-step form, dropdowns, checkboxes, a character limit, a file upload and a submit button, like real funder portals.
summary.what_they_offer: A safe place to watch the browser agent fill and submit a form.
summary.what_theyre_looking_for: Nothing. Submissions are only recorded in this portal (Settings shows the last few).
summary.how_to_apply: Click Apply. The agent opens the form, stops at the login page and asks you to step in. Sign in through the live view with the password shown on this page, press Resume, and the agent fills the two steps.
summary.worth_noting: The login is deliberately human-only so you can practise the hand-over.

portal.notes: Login page has an 'I'm not a robot' checkbox. The agent must hand this step to a human.

questions_note: This form is part of the portal, so the questions are exact.

questions.text: What year was your company founded?
Which industries are relevant to your company? (select all that apply)
